solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Almost all adopt state that's unassuming

indicators.note: to adopt is to take in, so the first piece takes the second inside it

parts.note: almost all, short of everything, is most
DE is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Delaware

explanation.surface: Nearly everyone takes on a humble manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone modest makes no claims for themselves, a plain synonym for unassuming.

parts.note: a mace is a heavy club
a rate is a charge or fee

explanation.surface: A golf or social club's fee is too high.
explanation.walkthrough: 'steep' looks like an adjective for a high price, but it is the verb meaning soak.
explanation.definitionFit: To macerate is to soften by soaking in liquid, which is to steep.

parts.note: an ending is a finish

explanation.surface: Counting on a deputy to complete the job.
explanation.definitionFit: Depending on something means relying on it.

indicators.note: upset in a down clue means turned upside down, so the letters run bottom to top

parts.note: VIPs are very important people, celebrities

explanation.surface: Famous people annoy an illicit trader.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiv is British slang for a flashy petty crook dealing in black-market goods, notably in wartime rationing.

clue.text: Turn defeat into a stroke of luck

parts.note: to wind something is to turn it, as with a handle or key
a fall is a defeat, as of a city or a government

explanation.surface: Advice to make a loss into a lucky break.
explanation.definitionFit: A windfall, literally fruit blown down, is an unexpected piece of good fortune.

indicators.note: a translation renders words in other forms, so these letters are rendered in another order

explanation.surface: Editing a translation started an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignited means set alight, so set off.

indicators.note: in places the regiment abbreviation inside the word for degrading

parts.note: demotion is reduction in rank, a degrading
LI is the military abbreviation for Light Infantry

explanation.surface: A light infantry unit suffers a humiliating loss.
explanation.definitionFit: A demolition in sport is a crushing defeat.

indicators.note: in shows that the letters are found inside the place name

explanation.surface: Agreeing to marry at Gretna Green.
explanation.walkthrough: Gretna Green is a Scottish village famous for runaway weddings, apt for consent.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: to agree to something is to assent or say yes to it.

clue.text: Social worker in house or shed

indicators.note: in puts the insect inside the zodiac house

parts.note: Leo is one of the twelve houses of the zodiac
an ant is a social insect worker

explanation.surface: A social worker is in the house or the shed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Social worker' looks like a job title, but it is the ant.
explanation.definitionFit: A lean-to is a shed with a roof resting against a wall.

parts.note: a son is a boy
to net is to earn after deductions, as take-home pay

explanation.surface: A lad brings a poem home.
explanation.definitionFit: A sonnet is a fourteen-line poem.

clue.text: Goat finds island a hard place

parts.note: Capri is an island in the Bay of Naples
a corn is a patch of hardened skin on the foot

explanation.surface: A goat comes across an island that is a tough spot to live.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a hard place' suggests rough terrain, but it is a corn on the foot.
explanation.definitionFit: Capricorn is the zodiac sign represented by a goat.

parts.note: M is an abbreviation for mark, as in a German currency
an aria is a solo song in opera

explanation.surface: Someone called Mark has written a song for a girlfriend.
explanation.definitionFit: Maria is a common female given name, so a girl's name.

definitions.meaning: a line or row, as of soldiers or taxis

explanation.walkthrough: Rotten Row is a riding track in London's Hyde Park, which makes the two words look like one name.
explanation.definitionFit: Rank serves both as an adjective for putrid and a noun for a line of things.

clue.text: Slippery elm features in second episode

indicators.note: the anagram appears inside, featured within, the word for second

parts.note: an instant is a moment, a second

indicators.note: something slippery slides about, so these letters shift position

explanation.surface: A slippery elm tree appears in the second part of a serial.
explanation.walkthrough: Slippery elm is a real tree, so 'Slippery' reads as its name rather than as the anagram signal, and 'features in' looks like a verb about the tree.
explanation.definitionFit: An instalment is one part of a serialised story, an episode.

indicators.note: modified means altered, so these letters are altered in order

explanation.surface: Discover that Labour has changed a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Floribunda is a type of rose bearing clusters of flowers, so a plant.

definitions.note: the definition is plural in sense, a group of musical notes

parts.note: a trip is a stumble or mistake
to let is to allow

explanation.surface: A mistake has been permitted in someone's written notes.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a triplet is a group of three notes played in the time of two.

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the editor's letters are read right to left

parts.note: ED, an editor, is the usual crossword journalist
a test is an examination or investigation

explanation.surface: Someone loathes a reporter who supports an inquiry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' looks like support, but it turns ED into DE.
explanation.definitionFit: To detest is to loathe intensely, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Most unusual oven, in two ways

indicators.note: in puts the cooker word between the abbreviations for ways
two asks for the abbreviation for a way to appear twice

parts.note: ST, street, is a way
a range is a kitchen stove with ovens

explanation.surface: An extremely odd oven, peculiar in two respects.
explanation.definitionFit: Strangest is the superlative of strange, so most unusual.

clue.text: Supporter, on the whole, is temperate

parts.note: a tee supports a golf ball
the total is the whole amount

explanation.surface: Overall, a supporter is moderate.
explanation.definitionFit: Teetotal means abstaining from alcohol, an extreme sense of temperate.

indicators.note: cooked suggests preparing, so these letters are worked over into new order

explanation.surface: A person named Garcia cooked a mushroom.
explanation.definitionFit: Agaric is a family name for gilled fungi, so a type of mushroom.

clue.text: Commando introduces Indian language to court

indicators.note: to introduce is to bring in, so the language goes inside the court abbreviation

parts.note: Hindi is a major language of India

explanation.surface: A soldier brings an Indian language to a law court.
explanation.walkthrough: The Chindits were a British-Indian special force fighting behind Japanese lines in Burma in the Second World War.
explanation.definitionFit: A Chindit was a member of those long-range commando units.

clue.text: Son has pluck exorcising a curse

indicators.note: to exorcise is to drive out, so one letter is expelled from the word

parts.note: pluck is courage or nerve

explanation.surface: A brave son drives out a curse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exorcising a' removes the letter A from COURAGE, leaving COURGE; the clue's 'a' is the deleted letter, not part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A scourge is an affliction or bane, something that acts as a curse.

clue.text: Complains about time in places of interest

indicators.note: about here means around, so the first piece goes around the second

parts.note: to sigh is to complain or lament

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles about the time spent at tourist spots.
explanation.definitionFit: Sights are notable attractions, places of interest to tourists.

clue.text: Trustworthy leaders going Awol? I can swallow that!

indicators.note: the leading letters go absent without leave, so the front two are dropped

parts.note: credible means believable, trustworthy

explanation.surface: A soldier's trusted superiors desert, which is hard to believe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I can swallow that!' sounds like 'I believe it', but means the thing can be eaten. Removing CR from CREDIBLE leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something edible is fit to be eaten, so one can swallow it.

parts.note: a draw is a tied result
bridge is a card game

explanation.surface: A strategy to secure a draw in a match.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawbridge is a raisable bridge protecting a castle, a defensive measure.

parts.note: AD, anno domini, marks the present era, nowadays
apt means suitable

explanation.surface: A style that is currently appropriate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fashion' looks like a noun for style, but it is the verb meaning shape.
explanation.definitionFit: To fashion something is to shape or modify it, to adapt it.

definitions.meaning: a single whole thing, the number one
a military detachment is a group of troops, a formation

explanation.definitionFit: A unit is both a single entity and a military group such as a detachment.

indicators.note: in places the royal letter inside the word for charge

parts.note: a fee is a charge
R stands for Rex or Regina, king or queen

explanation.surface: A monarch who is in charge has no limits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sovereign' could be the gold coin, but here it is R for the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Free means without restriction.

indicators.note: in places the element symbol inside the cereal word

parts.note: bran is the husk of cereal grain
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: A clever person added iodine to their breakfast cereal.
explanation.definitionFit: The brain behind a scheme is its mastermind, the person who plans it.

parts.note: to deter is to discourage
a gent is a man, a fellow

explanation.surface: Someone is putting off the man who cleans.
explanation.definitionFit: Detergent is a cleaning agent, so a cleaner.

clue.text: Former partners keep pamphlet of quotations

indicators.note: to keep is to hold, so the first piece holds the second inside

parts.note: exes, also written exs, are former partners
a tract is a short pamphlet

explanation.surface: Divorced spouses keep a booklet of famous sayings.
explanation.definitionFit: Extracts are passages quoted from a larger work, so quotations.

indicators.note: about here means around, so these letters are turned around into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone has learned the details of a hire fee.
explanation.definitionFit: A rental is the amount paid to hire something, a hire charge.
